review.assessment: This change creates a new src/lib.rs implementing word_frequencies by splitting input only on space characters and returning an unsorted vector from a HashMap. The implementation fails to handle case-insensitivity, does not split on non-alphanumeric delimiters like punctuation or tabs, and ignores the sorting requirement for frequency descending and alphabetical ascending order. Consequently, the function produces incorrect results for inputs containing mixed cases, punctuation, or whitespace other than space characters.

findings.expected: "["apple", 1), ("banana", 1)] (alphabetical tie-break) or sorted by count desc
